purpose: Fictional vectors to run through the product. Expected observations describe behavior, not production test results.

cases.given: A Thursday dinner is copied from a weekly rotation; Friday has two protected lunches. Active shopper Mia and a second planning adult Alex.
cases.when: Alex proposes moving dinner to Sunday. Mia reviews the effect.
expect: Friday lunches remain Friday unless deliberately moved
Proposal alone does not change shared basket

cases.given: One eight-pack has already been paid for. Two diners are away.
cases.when: An adult records the away night.
expect: Cash refund is zero unless separate settlement evidence arrives

cases.given: An invited contributor and a one-shop cook link each know the week identifier.
cases.when: They request the adult week endpoint.
expect: No calendar, names, private notes or budget returned

cases.given: A candidate soup uses an excluded ingredient and the yield of a pantry lot is unknown.
cases.when: Adult opens the idea, changes the ingredient and reviews quantities.
expect: Approval creates at most one accepted dinner
Scheduling and applying to shop are separate

cases.given: A household idea draft is open; a separate shop has a newer quote.
cases.when: User cancels or retries a prior idea request.
expect: Confirmed repeat of same intent never creates a second candidate

cases.given: Same as cash example except fee B is unknown or B lacks an essential pack.
expect: Shopper can enter the missing quote or leave unresolved

cases.given: Option B was previewed before the active shopper froze a different basket.
cases.when: An old device tries to adopt B.
expect: Conflict with current head or locked phase
No order placed or store route created
